title: 2016 Software Engineering Exit Exam
source: 2016-exitexam.pdf — Ethiopian national university exit exam (Software Engineering)

focusGuide.Networking: Review OSI/TCP-IP layers, subnetting, switches vs hubs, HTTP, and network security basics.
focusGuide.Project Management: Study agile vs waterfall, WBS, stakeholder management, Tuckman model, and ROI.
focusGuide.Database: Practice normalization (1NF–3NF), SQL INSERT/FOREIGN KEY, and ER-to-relational mapping.
focusGuide.Web Development: Review HTML/CSS selectors, HTTP methods (GET/POST), and JavaScript fundamentals.
focusGuide.Java / OOP: Focus on interfaces, abstract classes, inheritance, try-catch, and correct Java syntax.
focusGuide.Android: Study Activity, Intent, Manifest.xml, layout hierarchy (ViewGroup), and APK.
focusGuide.Operating Systems: Review process states, deadlock/banker's algorithm, paging, and CPU scheduling.
focusGuide.AI / ML: Study search algorithms (A*, UCS), agent types, and data mining CRISP-DM phases.
focusGuide.Software Engineering: Review testing goals, UML diagrams, traceability, and architecture documentation.
focusGuide.Security: Focus on CIA triad, ACLs, risk management, and common attack mitigations.
focusGuide.Data Structures: Practice time complexity, linear vs non-linear structures, and queue/stack use cases.
focusGuide.C++: Review for-loop syntax, valid identifiers, and basic I/O.
focusGuide.General: Re-read missed questions and verify concepts in your course notes.
